Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I3, to be performed 
on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block

Technical 
Data:

The first draft initiated 
by eng. 
Haytham Abdel Mohsen Hemdan, 
tested by eng 
Mohamed El Bayaa, 
revised by EDEPC quality control eng Adel Abd- El kader El Nagar, accepted 
by eng El Sayed Attiah Abd El Maksood general director, and approved by eng. 
Tarek Youssef Ali: 
Head Sector of 
Ayoun Moussa 
PS.

This document accepted by 
eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & 
MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: EDEPC 
planning & financial prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions

Maintenance 
and repair of the equipment should only be undertaken by trained, experience and 
authorized electrical personnel.

Use only insulated tools, 
particularly when connecting a battery. Stand on a rubber material.

Personal 
effects of metal such as rings, watches, bracelets and necklaces which may cause 
a short circuit and metal subjects (pens, tools etc.) which may fall from open 
pockets while bending over batteries or chargers should be removed.

Isolate all AC supplies, auxiliary supplies and the 
battery (open isolator, remove battery fuses or remove a battery link) before 
working on the equipment. And never handle a component or assembly without 
personally confirming that no voltage is applied pr present.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

Wear the appropriate 
 safety equipment as safety shoes, helmet,

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
Check all alarms and status indicators
Check meter readings are normal and compare them with the test certificate.

Check the cause of any significant changes as the change of load or recent 
 discharge.

Check ventilation devices
 are clean and clear of obstructions.

Visually check electrical connections and components for signs of 
 overheating or corrosion and rectify as necessary.
Check painted and plated components for signs of damage or corrosion.
Carry out a test discharge of the battery for the specific autonomy.

Check the fans are properly functioning and replace them by new ones 
 after 5 years.
